Denosumab (USAN, rINN) AMG-162; Dénosumab; Denosumabum. Денозумаб CAS — 615258-40-7. Profile Denosumab is a human monoclonal antibody that specifically targets the receptor activator of nuclear factor-kappa B ligand (RANKL), a mediator of the resorptive phase of bone remodel- ling. Denosumab is under investigation for various conditions, including osteoporosis, treatment-induced bone loss, rheumatoid arthritis, bone metastases, and multiple myeloma. ◊ References. 1.
